For more information on asynchronous speech recognition, see the [how-to](https://cloud.google.com/speech-to-text/docs/async-recognize).
data.description_suggestion: Performs asynchronous speech recognition on provided audio data. Accepts a LongRunningRecognizeRequest containing audio content or URI, RecognitionConfig with language and model settings, and optional TranscriptOutputConfig for output destination. Returns an Operation object immediately; use the operation name with the get operation to poll for results. The operation completes with either a LongRunningRecognizeResponse containing transcription results or an error status. Recommended for audio longer than 1 minute or when non-blocking processing is required.
